minutes.headline: Planning Board approved the 30 School Street food pantry site plan with conditions and backed housekeeping zoning changes.
minutes.summary: The board closed the continued hearing on the Lunenburg Food Pantry site plan at 30 School Street and approved it with conditions on trailer parking, gravel pad expansion, work hours and street light review. It then held a combined hearing on housekeeping zoning and bylaw amendments for the November special town meeting and recommended them favorably. Committee reports, meeting schedule and a stormwater bylaw revisit were also covered.

public_comment.topic: Concern about brightness of the street light at the end of her driveway possibly being changed in connection with the food pantry.
Chair invited public comment on the zoning amendments; none came from the room or Zoom.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing for 30 School Street site plan, PBSA 26-6.
Approve the site plan for 30 School Street with work hours, trailer parking on west side, gravel pad extension up to 10 ft, and board review of street light changes.
Close the public hearing on the zoning amendments for special town meeting.
Recommend all proposed zoning and general bylaw changes favorably at town meeting.

budget_items.what_was_said: A member said the town struggles to fund road design needed for a shovel-ready TIP project, which takes years to reach funding.
Proposed bylaw change would let the planning board set the stormwater permit fee schedule like other permits.

decisions.decision: Board agreed not to meet on December 28th and remove it from the schedule.
Minutes not approved; staff to add motion and vote details for 149 Summer Street and correct the note on Mr. Nicastro's recusal.
Stormwater permits will be issued separately from other decisions going forward because of the different appeal period.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the 30 School Street food pantry site plan with conditions on work hours, trailer parking, a gravel pad extension and street light review.
The board closed the continued public hearing on the site plan before the approval vote.
After a combined hearing, the board recommended all proposed zoning and general bylaw changes favorably for the November special town meeting.
The board deferred approval of its minutes until motion and vote details are added for 149 Summer Street and a recusal note is corrected.
The board will not meet on December 28th, and stormwater permits will be issued separately from other decisions because of a different appeal period.

why_it_matters: The pantry approval sets the conditions a neighbor will see on the site, including parking and any change to the nearby street light.
The zoning and bylaw changes the board backed are what voters will be asked to act on at the November special town meeting, including a change letting the board set stormwater permit fees.
